title: 第205章 他要当面领教陆大人的手段第204章 既然棘手你就更应该说实话
slug: 人在镇魔司红词加身只杀不渡
lines: 短暂沉默之后，周世安终是叹了口气，缓缓说道：
“陆大人慧眼如炬，下官也没什么好瞒的了。”
“昨日，玄清观弟子回去之后，孟怀玄得知孟守静之死，亲自来了朔阳驻所。”
“来找你？”陆渊眉头微挑。
“对，孟观主倒还守规矩，没有硬闯驻所，也没有对下面人动手，只是站在驻所大门外，让值守的镇魔卫传了一句话，要下官出去一见。”
周世安苦笑一声，“下官出去之后，他说念及玄清观与朔阳驻所所素来交好，只问一件事，杀他孙儿的人是谁？”
“下官没瞒他。”
周世安抬起眼，目光坦荡，“孟守静强闯封锁线在先，对官差出手在后，按大乾律死有余辜。”
“杀他的命令是持甲子荡魔令的陆大人下的，于法有据，于理无亏。”
“下官告诉他，若觉得处置不公，大可向州司申诉，驻所绝不以势压人。”
陆渊嗯了一声问道：“然后呢？”
周世安摇了摇头，道：“他不接受。”
“法理上他认，他的孙儿犯了死罪，镇魔司按律斩杀，他没二话。”
“但情理上，他咽不下这口气。”
“他知道这是公事，不是私仇，所以他不为难驻所，也不为属下，他只有一个要求——”
周世安顿了顿，目光落在陆渊脸上。
“他要当面领教陆大人的手段。”
陆渊点头，示意他继续说下去。
“孟怀玄说，他不追究旁人，也不找驻所麻烦，但杀他孙儿的人，总要站在他面前，让他看看配不配杀他孙儿。”
“他说只要陆大人能胜过他，孟守静之死便一笔勾销，玄清观与驻所之间一切照旧。”
“若是陆大人不去，今后陆大人行走江湖恐怕就不会那么顺畅。”
周世安擦了擦嘴角血丝，表情有些无奈：
“下官当然不能答应，孟怀玄是虚境五层，放眼整个清溪县也是顶尖的人物。”
“他年轻时便以符法霸道著称，虚境之后更是将玄清观的镇观符法修到大成，让您一个初入化境之人去对战他那种老牌化境，未免不够公允。”
“可他不肯退让，咬死了只要这个条件，下官跟他磨了半天，他根本不肯让步。”
周世安叹了口气，眼底闪过一丝不易察觉的懊恼与尴尬。
“下官当时想，孟怀玄虽在气头上，但毕竟是玄清观主，讲究体面，应该不会下官动手。”
“所以下官上去激了他一句，若是执意要对陆大人动手，就让下官领教领教他虚境五层的手段。”
“下官也是镇魔司的人，他要当着下官的面对镇魔都尉动手，总得先过了这一关再说。”
江不尘听得眉头一挑，大概能猜到接下来发生了什么。
“下官以为他不敢，毕竟下官是驻所统领，朝廷命官，他一个道门观主再横也不至于对驻所统领动手。”
“结果下官话音刚落，他便动了。”
周世安指了指自己胸口，说道：
“下官本以为他是做做样子，没想到虚境五层的灵力威压硬撼而来，仅仅一招，就把下官打成重伤，肋骨断了三根。”
“就这还是他前几招没有动用全力，留了几分余地，打完后他留了一句话，两日内见不到陆大人，他还会再来。”
陆渊轻点下颌，表示自己明白了。
周世安虽然没拦住孟怀玄，但这事本来也怪不到他头上。
content_en:
After a short silence, Zhou Shian finally sighed and said slowly:
"Master Lu has a keen eye, and I have nothing to hide from my subordinates."
"Yesterday, after the disciples of Xuan Qing Guan returned, Meng Huaixuan learned of Meng Shoujing's death and came to Shuoyang Station in person."
"Coming to find you?" Lu Yuan raised his eyebrows slightly.
"Yes, Guanzhu Meng still obeyed the rules. He did not forcefully break into the station, nor did he attack the people below. He just stood outside the gate of the station and asked the demon-suppressing guard on duty to pass a message to the lower official to go out and see him."
Zhou Shi'an smiled bitterly, "After the official left, he said that he remembered that Xuan Qing Guan and Shuoyang Resident Office had always been on good terms, and he only wanted to ask one thing, who was the person who killed his grandson?"
"The official didn't hide it from him."
Zhou Shi'an raised his eyes with a magnanimous gaze, "Meng Shoujing broke through the blockade first and attacked the official officer later. According to the law of the Qian Dynasty, he will die as he deserves."
"The order to kill him was given by Mr. Lu who holds the Jiazi Dang Demon Order. It is well-founded in the law and justified."
"The subordinate told him that if he felt that the treatment was unfair, he could appeal to the state secretary. The station would never use force to oppress others."
Lu Yuan hummed and asked, "What next?"
Zhou Shian shook his head and said, "He doesn't accept it."
"In legal terms, he admits that his grandson has committed a capital crime and the Demon Suppressor will kill him according to the law. He doesn't say anything."
"But logically, he can't swallow this breath."
"He knows that this is a business matter, not a personal vendetta, so he doesn't embarrass his station or his subordinates. He only has one request -"
Zhou Shi'an paused and his eyes fell on Lu Yuan's face.
"He wants to learn Master Lu's methods face to face."
Lu Yuan nodded and motioned for him to continue.
"Meng Huaixuan said that he would not pursue others or cause trouble to the resident, but the person who killed his grandson would always stand in front of him and let him see if he was worthy of killing his grandson."
"He said that as long as Mr. Lu can defeat him, Meng Shoujing's death will be wiped out, and everything between Xuanqing Temple and the station will remain as usual."
"If Mr. Lu doesn't go, Mr. Lu's travels in the world may not be so smooth in the future."
Zhou Shian wiped the bloodshot corners of his mouth with a helpless expression:
"Of course I can't agree. Meng Huaixuan is at the fifth level of the Void Realm, and he is also a top figure in the entire Qingxi County."
"He was known for his domineering talismans when he was young. After the virtual realm, he even perfected Xuan Qing Guan's talismans. It would be unfair for you, a newcomer to the realm, to fight against an experienced talisman like him."
"But he refused to give in. He insisted on this condition. Even though the official had been struggling with him for a long time, he refused to give in at all."
Zhou Shian sighed, a trace of imperceptible annoyance and embarrassment flashing through his eyes.
"The official thought at the time that although Meng Huaixuan was angry, he was the master of Xuanqing Temple after all. He was very honorable and would not take action against the official."
"So the official went up and provoked him. If he insists on taking action against Mr. Lu, let the official teach him how to use the fifth level of the virtual realm."
"Xia Guan is also from the Demon Suppression Division. If he wants to attack the Demon Suppression Captain in front of him, he has to pass this test first."
Jiang Buchen raised his eyebrows when he heard this, and he could probably guess what happened next.
"Xiaoguan thought he didn't dare. After all, Xiaguan is the commander of the station and an official of the imperial court. No matter how arrogant he is as a Taoist temple master, he will not attack the commander of the station."
"But as soon as the official finished speaking, he moved."
Zhou Shian pointed to his chest and said:
"Xiaoguan thought he was just showing off, but he didn't expect the spiritual pressure from the fifth level of the virtual realm to come over. With just one move, Xiaguan was seriously injured and three of his ribs were broken."
"That's why he didn't use all his strength in the first few attacks and left some room. After the attack, he left a message. If he doesn't see Mr. Lu within two days, he will come again."
Lu Yuan tapped his chin to show that he understood.
Although Zhou Shian did not stop Meng Huaixuan, this incident was not his fault.
